content:
Nina: Heads-up from QA: compact modal CTA alignment is off on 320px screens. The primary button baseline sits lower than other controls and the toast dismiss overlaps the modal close icon.

Owen: Repro'd. Root cause looks like `line-height` token for `.btn` was tightened in the compact variant, causing the button content to sit lower. Also toasts are rendered inside the modal container which is creating the overlap.

Ravi: Quick fixes: 1) restore `--btn-line-height` for compact to 20px, 2) make toasts render to `#portal` (body) and add margin-top when modals are open so they don't collide with close icons.

Taylor: Accessibility note: when we move toasts out to the portal, ensure `aria-live` remains set and focus order isn't disrupted. Also test with keyboard focus — dismiss button must be reachable via Tab without getting trapped behind the toast.

Nina: For buttons, prefer keeping text baseline consistent across density tokens. Proposal: introduce `--btn-baseline-offset` token and use it in compact/regular variants rather than changing `line-height` globally.

Owen: I like that. That means we can keep global typography stable. I'll sketch CSS:
```
.btn { line-height: var(--btn-line-height); }
.btn--compact { transform: translateY(var(--btn-baseline-offset)); }
```
This avoids tilting other components.

Ravi: For toasts, implementation detail: append to `document.body` and use fixed positioning with `top: env(safe-area-inset-top)` on mobile. That should avoid overlap and respect notches.

ui-bot: Reminder: include visual regression snapshots and a11y checklist when landing UI changes.

Taylor: Also add `prefers-reduced-motion` rule for toast entrance animations.

Nina: Action items: Owen - PR for baseline token + compact transform; Ravi - toast portal + safe-area handling; Taylor - update a11y checklist; Nina - update component docs. Target: next week demo.

Owen: On it, will include screenshots.

Ravi: Starting toast PR.

Taylor: Drafting checklist now.
